newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 corn output seen up to 118.5 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 corn output seen up to 118.5 mln tonnes.

text.p: China's corn output is expected to reach 118.5 million tonnes this year, up from 106 million tonnes in 1995, said the China Grains, Oils and Feeds newsletter.
The publication, made available on Sunday, forecast output for 1997 at 122.5 million tonnes.
However, it predicted little change in market prices in the first half of the year, saying any increase was unlikely before the second half.
Of major corn-producing provinces, output in northeastern Jilin and Heilongjiang provinces was seen increasing by 5.0 million tonnes this year over 1995 totals, it said.

In the northwestern region of Xinjiang, output was seen rising by 339,000 tonnes to 3.087 million tonnes, while in central Henan province output was set to increase by 6.1 percent to 10.15 million tonnes this year.
Production in the southwestern province of Sichuan province would increase by 9.53 percent to 7.28 million tonnes this year.
